get.summary: Get an issue type's Operator workflow document
get.description:
Returns the issue type verbatim, in the same shape as the `<KEY>.json` files
in a hosted collection bundle (`/schemas/issuetype.json`). This is the
*native* Operator workflow - the ordered step graph every export format is
derived from - so the web UI and the docs site render identical graphs from
identical bytes. Prefer [`get_one`] for display metadata; use this when you
need the full step structure including step types, reject edges, and
per-type fan-out configuration.

parameters.description: Issue type key (e.g., FEAT, FIX)

the database: a liveness failure restarts the pod, and restarting will not
fix a corrupt database - it would just crash-loop.

AgentProfile.description:
A canonical cross-tool agent definition (serialized as `agent-profile.json`).

Shared core (`name`/`provider`/`model`/`system_prompt`/`skills`/`mcp_servers`/
`tools`) plus namespaced extension bags. `x_operator` is typed (Operator owns
those fields); `x_agnt` and `x_openai` are opaque per-platform pass-throughs.

mcp_servers.description: MCP server names. Preserved opaquely across import.

oneOf.description: Declarative reference to a remote, named agent. `None` = a locally launchable agent, not bound to a remote target.

skills.description: Named skills. Preserved opaquely across import.

system_prompt.description: System prompt. This is preserved opaquely across import (see [`Delegator::unmapped_core`]).

tools.description: Tool names. Preserved opaquely across import.

x_openai.description: OpenAI-owned extension fields, opaque (`instructions`, `tools`, `tool_resources`, `metadata`, thread refs, ...).

oneOf.description: Operator-owned extension fields (typed). `None` when the agent carries no Operator-specific configuration.

ticket_path.description: Path to the created ticket file

KanbanStatusMapping.description:
Explicit mapping from operator's strict todo/doing/done states to the
external board's column/status names.

Drives bidirectional sync: issues are pulled from the `todo` column,
pushed to `doing` when a ticket is claimed, to `done` when completed, and
back to `todo` when requeued. Unset fields fall back per-transition
(`doing` → "In Progress", `done` → "Done"); requeue only pushes when
`todo` is explicitly mapped.

SupportStatus.description: Official support / maturity level of an advertised integration.

SyncKanbanIssueTypesResponse.description: Response from syncing kanban issue types from a provider.

tools.description: LLM CLIs reported by `opr8r tools --json` on the target. Empty if unreachable/unknown.

TickReport.description: What one tick did, or would do when assessed.

TicketAgent.description: The agent working a ticket, as shown on the ticket page.

attach_command.description: Shell command that attaches to the session (tmux)

last_message.description: Latest status message from the agent

paired.description: Whether the operator works alongside the agent (SPIKE and INV tickets)

pr_status.description: Last known PR/MR status: open, approved, `changes_requested`, merged or closed

pr_url.description: URL of the PR/MR opened by the "pr" step

remote_host.description: SSH host the agent runs on, when remote

session_context_ref.description: Session context reference (cmux workspace, tmux window)

session_pane_ref.description: Session pane reference (cmux surface, tmux pane)

session_window_ref.description: Session window reference (cmux window, tmux session)

target_name.description: Execution target the agent launched on

workspace_url.description: Coder dashboard URL of the agent's workspace

worktree_path.description: Git worktree the agent works in

TicketDependency.description: One `depends_on` reference and where it points.

reference.description: The reference as written (local id or `provider:key`)

ticket_id.description: Local ticket it resolves to; absent while unsynced

TicketDetailResponse.description: Full ticket details including content and metadata

oneOf.description: The agent working this ticket, if any

collection.description: Collection the ticket's issue type comes from

content.description: Full markdown content of the ticket

dependents.description: Local tickets whose `depends_on` names this ticket

external_id.description: External issue ID from kanban provider

external_url.description: URL to the issue in the external provider

status.description: Current status: queued, running, awaiting, completed

ticket_type.description: Ticket type: FEAT, FIX, INV, SPIKE

TicketPriority.description:
Ticket urgency, as constrained by `src/schemas/ticket_metadata.schema.json`.

Variants are declared most-urgent first, so the derived `Ord` is the sort order.

oneOf.description: Poll for a previously approved device authorization.
Redeem a rotating refresh token.
Exchange a service access key.

TokenRequest.description:
Token endpoint request. The discriminator makes unrelated credential
combinations unrepresentable.

TokenResponse.description: A newly issued access token, and a refresh token when the grant produces one.

refresh_token.description:
Opaque rotating refresh token. Absent for access-key exchange, which is
re-exercised with the key itself rather than refreshed.

UpdateConfigurationRequest.description: Field-level patch for the public operational configuration.

UpdateIssueTypeRequest.description: Request to update an issue type

UpdateModelServerRequest.description:
Request to update an existing user-declared model server.

All fields except `kind` are replaced; `name` is taken from the path.

api_key_env.description: Name of an env var providing the API key

base_url.description: Base URL of the inference endpoint

UpdateTicketStatusRequest.description: Request to update a ticket's status

status.description: Target status: queued, running, awaiting, done

UpdateTicketStatusResponse.description: Response from updating a ticket's status

ValidateKanbanCredentialsRequest.description: Request to validate kanban credentials without persisting them.

ValidateKanbanCredentialsResponse.description:
Response from validating kanban credentials.

`valid: false` is returned for auth failures - never a 4xx/5xx HTTP
status - so clients can display `error` inline without exception handling.

WorkflowExportResponse.description: Response for exporting a ticket to a Claude dynamic workflow (`.js`).

issuetype_key.description: The issue type key that supplied the step structure.

suggested_filename.description: Suggested filename for saving the workflow (`<ticket-id>.workflow.js`).

ticket_id.description: The ticket the workflow was generated from.

WorkflowFormat.description: Which orchestration format `workflow export` should emit.

WorkflowFormatDto.description:
One workflow export format operator can emit, for `GET /api/v1/workflow-formats`.

A projection of [`WorkflowFormat`] joined to its `Workflows` catalog entry -
the single source of truth for the format's [`SupportStatus`] and docs. Lets
the UIs render a format picker without hardcoding the list.

docs_url.description: Absolute docs URL, or `null` if undocumented.

extension.description: File extension of the emitted artifact, no leading dot (e.g. "js", "json").

slug.description: Stable slug (e.g. "claude", "agnt") - the value the `format` query param takes.

status.description: Official support / maturity status (from the catalog).

WorkflowHintsDto.description: Descriptive workflow hints for a collection (v1: metadata only).

WorkflowPreviewResponse.description:
Response for a *preview* workflow generated from an issue type alone (no
concrete ticket). Used by the UI to visualize an issue type's workflow shape.

contents.description: The generated `.js` workflow source (placeholder ticket values).

issuetype_key.description: The issue type key the preview was generated from.

suggested_filename.description: Suggested filename for saving the preview (`<KEY>.preview.workflow.js`).
